general_items.evidence_caveat: Court reporting is dated October 20. The summary is non-graphic and excludes identifying details about the victim.

general_items.evidence_caveat: Charges were brought on October 19 and reported on October 20. These are allegations, not convictions.

general_items.headline: Britain has approved production at the Jackdaw gas field.

general_items.evidence_caveat: The government’s October 21 release confirms consent. Production timing is a government projection; no claim is made that the project will lower retail energy prices.

general_items.headline: UK inflation rose to three-point-five percent in September.
general_items.title: UK inflation rose to three-point-five percent in September.
general_items.context: Official figures show an increase from three-point-one percent in August, with motor fuels the main upward driver.
general_items.evidence_caveat: The original ONS bulletin verifies September inflation. The figure describes an observed month, not a forecast or central-bank decision.

general_items.evidence_caveat: October 20 reporting by Alexander Brown was retrieved through AOL; the Bloomberg page was inaccessible. This is an attributed statement, not a guarantee of final Budget policy.

general_items.evidence_caveat: Reuters reports Greene’s October 20 speech. This is one policymaker’s position, not a Monetary Policy Committee decision. The upstream Breeden subclaim was not verified and is omitted.
